resources.string: Stops navigation answers cutting announcements, the 100 ms speech wait cap, focus priority, the small audio buffer, focused-node reuse within one swipe, region-grained order freshness and live-tree answers in swipe bursts, and the speaking-nodes cache for edge checks.
Work out speech for the next and previous swipe targets while the current item is being read. Available only while Turn off latency extras is off.
Also work out speech for the item after the adjacent target in each swipe direction. This can use more processing.

Lower levels coalesce more repeated noncritical events across event types and favor focus. Very low/low keep one pending event per coalescible type, medium two, high four, and very high eight. Announcements, notifications, window changes, clicks, text/input, and touch-state events are always kept.
